# Lab 3.2: Load from Cloud Storage: All Formats

## What We Are Going to Do
Create files in five formats in Cloud Storage, then load each one with wildcards and compare how each format handles the schema.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a bucket and export sample files in every format.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">export BUCKET=$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs
gcloud storage buckets create gs://$BUCKET --location=US
for FMT in CSV JSON AVRO PARQUET; do
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false "
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (
  uri = 'gs://$BUCKET/formats/$(echo $FMT | tr A-Z a-z)/names-*',
  format = '$FMT', overwrite = TRUE $( [ $FMT = CSV ] &amp;&amp; echo ", header = TRUE")
) AS
SELECT name, gender, state, year, number
FROM \`bigquery-public-data.usa_names.usa_1910_current\` WHERE year = 2020"
done
gcloud storage ls -r gs://$BUCKET/formats/</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Load each format with a wildcard.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq load --source_format=CSV --skip_leading_rows=1 --autodetect lab03.names_csv "gs://$BUCKET/formats/csv/names-*"
bq load --source_format=NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON --autodetect lab03.names_json "gs://$BUCKET/formats/json/names-*"
bq load --source_format=AVRO lab03.names_avro "gs://$BUCKET/formats/avro/names-*"
bq load --source_format=PARQUET lab03.names_parquet "gs://$BUCKET/formats/parquet/names-*"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Avro and Parquet need no schema and no auto-detect. They carry the schema inside the file.

3. **[Console] Load ORC through the UI.** BigQuery can't export ORC, so use Google's sample ORC file. On `lab03` click **Create table**:
   - **Source**: Google Cloud Storage → `gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/us-states/us-states.orc`
   - **File format**: ORC
   - **Table**: `states_orc`

4. **[SQL] Compare the results.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">

</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT 'csv' AS fmt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lab03.names_csv UNION ALL
SELECT 'json', COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_json UNION ALL
SELECT 'avro', COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_avro UNION ALL
SELECT 'parquet', COUNT(*) FROM lab03.names_parquet;</span>
</code></pre>

5. **[CLI] Compare the schemas.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">for T in names_csv names_json names_avro names_parquet; do echo "== $T"; bq show --schema lab03.$T; done</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `year` is `INTEGER` everywhere, but CSV and JSON needed auto-detect to guess it.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Row counts | Same for all four formats |
| Avro / Parquet / ORC | Schema read from the file |
| CSV / JSON | Need a schema or auto-detect |
| Wildcards | One load for many files |
